lab_title: Which tenant gets the fixed service?
lab_assumptions: Finite time-zero burst; equal one-second jobs; 12 queued jobs per tenant; A/B/C insertion order; B/C offer six each; WRR weights 2:1:1. Retry copies use unsafe fresh keys. No distributed or variable-token fairness claim.

diagrams.title: Before: scaled app, fixed provider
diagrams.description: App replicas and immutable cache preserve trusted history/retrieval. The shared model provider remains capacity limited across tenants.

diagrams.title: After: bounded fair provider dispatch
diagrams.description: Trusted admission and tenant queues bound waiting work. Fair turns allocate existing service. A shared atomic guard grants provider budgets before execution, preserving unknown outcomes.

diagrams.title: Admission through settlement
diagrams.description: Validate, admit, select, reserve, execute, settle. Rejection reaches no provider; uncertain termination retains a slot rather than inventing cancellation.
